evidence_group_semantics: AND across groups; OR across alternatives in each group; partial spans are conjunctive pieces of one evidence item.
table_quote_semantics: Structured row JSON with column labels; not claimed to be a contiguous verbatim PDF sentence.
locator_conventions: Physical PDF page: 1-based. Block/subtable/row indices and character offsets: 0-based; char_end exclusive.

review.author: assistant
review.review_method: Relevant original PDF text checked; PDF pages 37 and 193 visually checked for tables.
review.scope: Original dataset construction checks; model-call flags here describe construction only.

split: Fixed ten-question local evaluation/regression set; no separate development/held-out split and no new-question generation.
limitations: Only these ten questions are used; no independent held-out set or broad accuracy claim.
q009 and q010 are excluded from retrieval metrics; boundary behavior is reported separately.
Answers were reviewed by the assistant, not independently human-blind-reviewed.
questions_hash_note: questions_sha256 hashes actual on-disk bytes; questions_text_lf_sha256 hashes LF-normalized text. Earlier manifest used LF hash for the CRLF file; question contents and file bytes are unchanged.
